jobs.title: Data Engineer, Enterprise Analytics Transformation
jobs.description: Location: Houston, TX Work Arrangement: On-site, 5 days per week Company: EIQdigital Position Summary EIQdigital is seeking a Data Engineer to support a large-scale Enterprise Analytics transformation initiative built on Microsoft Fabric. This role is hands-on with data platform implementation. The Data Engineer will build ingestion pipelines, transformation logic, lakehouse structures, data quality controls, and reusable engineering patterns that support a secure, governed, cloud-based analytics environment. The Data Engineer will work closely with Technical Architects, Data Analysts, Business Analysts, and business stakeholders to convert approved data and analytics requirements into reliable, scalable, and well-governed data assets. The ideal candidate combines strong technical delivery skills with structured engineering discipline and is comfortable working in modern cloud data platforms where governance, quality, security, and traceability are core requirements. This role requires full-time, on-site presence in Houston, five days per week. Key Responsibilities Data Ingestion and Pipeline Development • Build reusable ingestion pipelines for enterprise data sources across structured and semi- structured datasets • Develop batch and, where applicable, near real-time data movement patterns aligned to approved architecture standards • Implement parameterized, repeatable dataflows and pipelines within Microsoft Fabric or comparable cloud analytics platforms • Support source system connectivity, extraction logic, landing patterns, and ingestion scheduling • Implement error handling, retry logic, logging, and monitoring to support pipeline reliability Lakehouse and Data Platform Implementation • Build and maintain data assets across bronze, silver, and gold layers • Preserve raw source data in bronze layers for auditability, replay, and traceability • Develop standardized silver-layer datasets using approved schemas, identifiers, and business rules • Build curated gold-layer datasets to support reporting, analytics, and semantic models • Apply naming conventions, table design standards, folder structures, and engineering patterns defined by the architecture team Data Transformation, Modeling, and Quality • Translate technical specifications, source-to-target mappings, and business rules into scalable transformation logic • Develop SQL, Spark, Python, or Fabric-native transformations to cleanse, standardize, and integrate data • Implement data validation rules, reconciliation checks, referential integrity controls, and exception handling • Support data profiling and remediation activities in partnership with Data Analysts and business stakeholders • Ensure transformation logic is documented, version-controlled, testable, and aligned to approved requirements Governance, Security, and Lineage • Implement engineering controls that support data classification, lineage, retention, and access requirements • Support integration with data catalog, metadata, and governance tools such as Microsoft Purview or similar • Ensure datasets are traceable from source through transformation to downstream consumption • Apply role-based access, masking, and secure handling requirements in coordination with security and platform teams • Support auditability, reproducibility, and compliance-aligned data management practices Platform Operations and Delivery Support • Monitor pipeline execution, data freshness, failures, and performance issues • Support deployment of data engineering assets across development, test, and production environments • Participate in sprint planning, technical design reviews, build activities, testing, and production readiness • Collaborate with QA to validate pipeline reliability, data accuracy, and downstream analytics readiness • Contribute to reusable frameworks, templates, documentation, and data engineering standards Required Qualifications • 3 to 5 years of experience in data engineering, enterprise analytics, cloud data platforms, or data warehouse implementation • Strong SQL skills and experience working with large, complex datasets • Hands-on experience with modern cloud analytics platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, Databricks, Snowflake, or similar • Understanding of medallion architecture concepts, including bronze, silver, and gold layers • Experience building ingestion pipelines, transformation workflows, orchestration logic, and reusable data engineering components • Experience implementing data quality checks, reconciliation logic, logging, and exception handling • Familiarity with source-to-target mapping, schema design, data modeling, and enterprise data standards • Ability to collaborate with architects, analysts, and business stakeholders • Strong documentation discipline and comfort working in structured delivery environments Preferred Qualifications • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, Spark, notebooks, or related Fabric capabilities • Experience with Microsoft Purview or similar data catalog, lineage, and governance tools • Exposure to Power BI semantic models or downstream analytics consumption patterns • Experience working in regulated, high-security, or multi-stakeholder environments • Familiarity with RBAC, data classification, masking, audit logging, and secure data handling practices • Experience supporting large-scale data migration, modernization, or cloud analytics transformation initiatives • Familiarity with DevOps, CI/CD, version control, or automated deployment practices • Basic scripting experience using Python, PySpark, or similar languages

jobs.title: Databricks Data Engineer with Azure
jobs.description: Position: Databricks Data Engineer with Azure Location: Houston, TX (4 days hybrid onsite) Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Azure + Databricks Data Engineer to design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data solutions using Microsoft Azure and Databricks. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience with PySpark, SQL, Azure Data Factory, and Delta Lake. Key Responsibilities Design and develop scalable ETL/ELT data pipelines using Azure and Databricks. Build data processing solutions using Databricks, Apache Spark, and PySpark. Develop and optimize SQL queries and data transformations. Create and manage pipelines using Azure Data Factory (ADF). Work with Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS/ADLS Gen2) for data ingestion and storage. Implement data solutions using Delta Lake and Databricks. Perform data integration from multiple sources and ensure data quality and reliability. Optimize Spark jobs, Databricks notebooks, and data pipelines for performance. Work with Unity Catalog for data governance and access management. Support deployment and CI/CD processes using Azure DevOps. Troubleshoot data pipeline failures and resolve production issues. Collaborate with data architects, analysts, developers, and business teams. Required Skills Strong experience as a Data Engineer with Azure and Databricks. Hands-on experience with Databricks, Apache Spark, and PySpark. Strong SQL skills. Experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF). Experience with Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS/ADLS Gen2). Strong understanding of Delta Lake and data lake architecture. Experience developing ETL/ELT pipelines. Knowledge of Databricks Unity Catalog and data governance. Experience with Azure DevOps and CI/CD. Good understanding of data modeling, data integration, and data quality. Preferred Skills Experience with Terraform or Infrastructure as Code. Knowledge of Azure Event Hubs/Kafka. Experience with Delta Live Tables (DLT). Familiarity with cloud security and Azure IAM. Experience working in Agile development environments.
